spark_open.description: The creature is a single quadrupedal hybrid shown in right-facing profile, with the overall size, posture, fur, head and limbs of a brown bear combined with insect-like structures on its back and forehead. It is covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is darker brown on the lower legs and back and lighter tan on the muzzle, cheeks and flanks, standing on four sturdy legs with a very short tail at the rear. A large, glossy, dark reddish-brown segmented shell covers the entire dorsal surface from just behind the shoulders to the rump, and a single long, curved, dark horn with jagged notches projects upward from the forehead. The head is bear-like with a long snout and black nose, small rounded ears, and brown eyes, and a row of oval openings is visible on the fur of the flank just below the lower edge of the shell.

meta_spark.description: A large four-legged mammal with thick shaggy brown fur stands in side view facing right, with a bear-like head, body, legs and paws. Its back from behind the shoulders to the rump is covered by a dark glossy reddish-brown segmented dome-like shell with a larger smooth shield over the shoulders, and a row of oval holes runs in the fur along the flank just below the shell edge. A single long glossy black curved horn with tooth-like projections on its inner edge rises from the center of the forehead and curves up and back.
